name: Apple-inspired Design Guidelines
description: Visual design system derived from Apple.com reference screenshots (WWDC hero, iPhone 17 promo, legal fine-print, product carousel).
designPrinciples: Generous negative space — let content breathe; never crowd the viewport.
Center-aligned hero compositions with product or logo as the focal subject.
Strict typographic hierarchy: oversized display headlines, short taglines, restrained body text.
High contrast between background and type; rely on neutrals plus a single accent blue for action.
Imagery does the talking — avoid decorative gradients, borders, or shadows around product photos.
Light surfaces by default; flip to deep black for cinematic/marquee moments.
Motion and interaction are subtle: hover state changes are minimal, transitions soft.

fontFamily.primary: 'SF Pro Display', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
fontFamily.text: 'SF Pro Text', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

headlineLarge.usage: Tile/card headings (Apple for College, MacBook Air)

subhead.usage: Hero subtitles, taglines under product names

treatment.smallcapsOrUppercase: Avoid uppercase for headlines; reserve for tiny eyebrow labels only.

shadows.philosophy: Use sparingly. Apple aesthetic is mostly flat; rely on background contrast and whitespace, not drop shadows.

compact.usage: Inline tile CTAs in two-column promo grid

darkVariant.subjectTreatment: Centered glowing product/logo with soft radial vignette

lightVariant.subjectTreatment: Product photography flush to bottom of section
lightVariant.ctaPlacement: Inline pair: primary filled + secondary outlined

promoTile.background: Light tinted (white, soft blue, soft pink, etc.)

textBlock.title: 32px semibold
textBlock.ctaRow: Primary pill button + text link with chevron, centered, 16px gap

productCarousel.scrollBehavior: Horizontal snap, partial next card visible to hint at scrollability

imagery.style: Studio product photography on flat or softly tinted backgrounds.
treatment: Always crisp, never filtered or color-graded artistically.
Subtle drop shadow under product is acceptable; never an outer glow except for hero marquees.
Pastel/tinted backgrounds telegraph product family (peach=Pro, mint=Air, lavender=standard, pink=mini).
doNot: Overlay text directly on product imagery in dense areas.
Use stock photography of people in product carousels.
Apply heavy gradients, vignettes, or grain to product shots.

patterns: Button hover: 150ms background color shift, no scale.
Carousel slide: 400ms ease-out, snap to card.
Hero entry: subtle fade + 8px translate-up on load, 500ms.
Reduce-motion: replace transforms with simple opacity fades.

accessibility.minimumContrast: WCAG AA — 4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large text.
accessibility.focusState: 2px solid #0071E3 outline with 2px offset; never remove outlines without replacement.
accessibility.altText: All product imagery requires descriptive alt text; decorative images use empty alt.

behavior: Two-column promo tiles collapse to single column below 735px.
Display headlines step down ~30% on mobile (e.g., 80px → 48px).
Top nav collapses to hamburger + Apple logo + bag below 833px.
Section vertical padding halves on mobile.

voiceAndTone.headlines: Short, declarative, sometimes a coined word (e.g., 'Magichromatic.').
voiceAndTone.taglines: Two short sentences max, often ending with periods for emphasis.
voiceAndTone.legalCopy: Dense, precise, set in 12px gray, justified left, never decorated.
